# FreeGadget

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

```blitzbasic
FreeGadget gadget%
```

**Works in:** BlitzPlus

Removes a gadget for good, together with everything inside it. If you only want it gone for a while use [HideGadget](HideGadget). The handle must not be used afterwards.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Free", 10, 10, 300, 140, Desktop(), 3)
b   = CreateButton("Remove me", 10, 10, 120, 28, win)
Repeat
	e = WaitEvent()
	If e = $401 Then FreeGadget b
Until e = $803
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gadget` | Int | required | Handle of the gadget. A window can be freed too. |
